title: General definitions.
bodyText:
As used in this chapter:

"Media" means any printed publication of general distribution in the State issued once or more per year that is a party to the Mutual Publishing Plan Agreement as executed on May 31, 1962, and any subsequent amendments.
bodyHtml:
[§480B-1]  General definitions.  As used in this chapter:

     "Media" means any printed publication of general distribution in the State issued once or more per year that is a party to the Mutual Publishing Plan Agreement as executed on May 31, 1962, and any subsequent amendments. [L 1995, c 243, pt of §2]
